summary_of_record_of_events: Co up at 0200, moved from Hamich ~3000 yds N to Heistern, attacked high ground at 0730; halted by small-arms fire and artillery; Co Comdr wounded, Exec Off (Lt Klenk) reorganized Co into one platoon of two squads; 1530 renewed infantry-tank assault took objective; counterattacks at 1800 and with tanks at 2100 stopped with division artillery fired onto own positions. 'Total casulaties for the day - 2 Off LWA, 7 EM KIA, 19 EM WIA.' 47 replacements (incl. Blakley) carried as joined as of 21 Nov.
In defensive position. Heavy artillery shelling; pressure relieved by attacks on left and right. New officers joined (1st Lt Arthur J. Bouchard assigned as Co Comdr).
Remained in position; heavy shelling; one squad moved 200 yds farther into the woods as an outpost.
Relieved at 2000 hrs W of Langerwehe; hiked ~1 1/4 mi to Heistern, trucked ~5 mi to bivouac, arrived 2250. 76 more replacements joined as of 26 Nov (SO 107).
Reorganization, cleaning equipment. 6 EM reported MIA as of 23 Nov.
Reorganization; in the afternoon all replacements went to Hamich to fire their weapons. 1 EM previously MIA officially KIA as of 23 Nov.
Replacements finished firing on the range in the morning; reorganization continued.
Hiked ~7 mi to Hucheln, billeted in a block of apartment houses. Company reorganized under T/O&E 7-17. Strength 183 present + 12 absent = 195 EM.
Assembly area: firing rifle grenades and rocket launchers, bathing, change of clothes, training (calisthenics, digging foxholes), enemy aircraft overhead, one plane shot down.
Trucked ~15 mi; relieved C Co 60th Inf (9th Div) in the woods; defensive position under enemy observation, wiring and sandbagging positions, patrols.
Rest area: close-order drill, Red Cross Clubmobile coffee and doughnuts, showers, movies, 50% passes, cleaning equipment.
Alerted in the morning; loaded on trucks 1630, traveled ~26 mi to Robertville, arrived 2258, went straight into defensive positions and dug in (start of the German Ardennes offensive).
Moved forward, set up road blocks S of Weywertz along the main highway; patrols; light shelling; enemy patrol ran into outposts.

Strong enemy attack before dawn held; at daylight Co gathered prisoners - 'captured 43 and killed about the same number'. 21 Dec: an enemy company marching down the road ambushed by 3rd Platoon (12 killed, 4-5 wounded); enemy tank, artillery and mortar fire on positions; patrols. 6 EM reported MIA as of 20 Dec.

summary_of_record_of_events: Improving positions with wire and mines under tank and artillery fire; relieved by K Co on 24 Dec and moved into reserve in Weywertz.
In reserve: 'Did not do anything except celebrate Christmas.' Officer combat patrol at 2100; Lt McLaughlin hit and believed killed.
Reserve: weapons classes, radio classes, patrols to the front; shelling at dinner time, no casualties.
